observations: Photo 0 shows a long black soundbar resting on a subwoofer, with a JBL logo visible on the side of the soundbar. A large speaker with a red JBL logo is in the background.

Photo 1 shows the same soundbar and two matching rear speakers placed on a table. The back of the rear speakers has ports and labels, but no readable model numbers. The soundbar has a central control panel with buttons.

Photo 2 is a close-up of the soundbar on the subwoofer, showing the JBL logo again. A hand is visible holding a remote or tool. The background includes a large speaker with a red JBL logo and a mesh grille.

All three photos show the same set: a soundbar, a subwoofer, and two rear speakers. The JBL branding is visible on the soundbar and the large speaker in the background, but not clearly on the rear speakers or subwoofer.
The environment appears to be a store or workshop with cardboard boxes and other electronics visible.

claims.evidence: JBL logo and 'Bar 500' text are visible on the side of the soundbar in photo 0 and photo 2.

The system includes a soundbar, subwoofer, and two rear speakers, which is consistent with 5.1. However, no label or text confirms the channel count. The photos do not show any internal wiring or configuration that would confirm 5.1.
No power rating is visible on any component in the photos. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images.
No Dolby Atmos logo or text is visible on any component. The feature cannot be confirmed from the photos.
No 'MultiBeam' or related text is visible on any component. The feature cannot be confirmed from the photos.

A video of the system powered on, showing all buttons working and sound output.

response.reason: The model is identified as JBL Bar 500 from visible logos, but key claims (5.1 channels, 590W, Dolby Atmos, MultiBeam) are unverifiable from the photos. There are hidden risks of incomplete set, damage, or counterfeit. Proof is needed to confirm functionality, completeness, and authenticity before pricing.
